features.title: Everything billing needs, nothing it doesn’t
features.lead: Five things Invroot does properly. Every one of them is a screen you can reach on the free plan.

items.title: Send an invoice in under a minute
items.short: Client, lines, done. Tax, numbering and totals handle themselves.
items.body: Pick a client, add your lines, and Invroot handles the tax, the numbering and the running total. Save it and choose whether to email it, download the PDF, or share a payment link.
points: Your own tax rates, applied per line

items.title: PDFs that look like your company, not ours
items.short: Your logo, stamp and signature on every document you send.
items.body: Upload your logo, stamp and signature once. Every invoice, quote and receipt carries them — the documents your client receives are yours end to end.

items.title: Full right-to-left, not a translation layer
items.short: The whole interface flips to Arabic, and so does the invoice.
items.body: Switch the whole interface to Arabic, and issue each invoice in the language its recipient reads. Layout, numerals and document direction all follow.

items.title: Know what you are owed, and chase it
items.short: Receivables, overdue and cash flow on one screen.
items.body: Receivables, overdue and cash flow on one screen, so the question “who still owes us?” has an answer you can act on.

items.title: Make the books and the bank agree
items.short: Match your records against the bank statement, line by line.
items.body: Match each payment you recorded against the credit on your statement. Invroot suggests the likely pairs; you decide, because a wrong match is far more expensive to unpick than a right one is to make.
points: Suggested matches by amount and date

steps.title: Three steps from job done to money in
steps.lead: No setup project and no accountant required. This is the whole flow.

items.d: Name, tax ID and terms. Once, then reuse.
items.detail: Name, tax ID, address and payment terms — entered once, then reused on every document that follows. If you already keep a client list, import it rather than retyping it.

items.d: Lines, tax and totals calculated as you type.
items.detail: Choose the client, add your lines, and watch your tax rates, the line totals and the invoice total settle as you type. The number is assigned in sequence with no gaps — a gap in a tax-registered numbering series is a question you would rather not answer later.

items.d: Email it, or share a link your client can pay from.
items.detail: Save, then choose how it goes out: email it with your branding, download the PDF, or share a link your client can pay from. Reminders chase the ones that go quiet, so you do not have to.

faq.title: Answers before you sign up
faq.lead: If yours is not here, email support@invroot.com and a person will reply.

items.q: Can it handle my country's tax rules?
items.a: You define your own tax rates — any name, any percentage, inclusive or compound, as many as you need. Invoices carry your tax ID, apply your rates per line, and show the tax total separately, which is the format most jurisdictions require.

items.q: Can I issue invoices in Arabic?
items.a: Yes. The whole interface switches to Arabic with proper right-to-left layout, and you choose the language per invoice, so an Arabic client gets an Arabic document.

items.q: Which currencies can I invoice in?
items.a: All 140 ISO currency codes, chosen per invoice and per client, so you can bill a customer in their money and keep your books in yours. Your own subscription is billed in AED wherever you are.

items.q: What happens on the free plan?
items.a: You can try every feature and send one real invoice to a real client. When you need more, Starter lifts the limits.

items.q: Do I need a card to start?
items.a: No. The free plan needs no payment details at all. You only enter a card if you choose to subscribe.

items.q: Can my whole team use it?
items.a: Starter includes up to five team members on one workspace, each with their own sign-in.
Yes — check receivables, review invoices and record payments from your phone.

uae.title: VAT invoicing software for the UAE
uae.lead: Issue tax invoices in Arabic and English with your TRN, 5% VAT and AED handled for you — and bill overseas clients in their own currency from the same account.

intro.title: Built for how UAE businesses bill
intro.body: A UAE tax invoice has to carry the right details: your Tax Registration Number, the VAT charged, the total in AED and, for many customers, an Arabic version. Invroot puts those on every document by default, so a compliant invoice is the normal output — not a template you have to assemble.

features.title: Everything a UAE invoice needs, on by default

items.title: 5% VAT, calculated automatically
items.body: Set 5% once and it applies per line, with the VAT amount and the total shown separately the way a tax invoice requires. Zero-rated and exempt lines are supported for the cases that need them.

items.title: Your TRN on every tax invoice
items.body: Add your Tax Registration Number once and it prints on every invoice, quote and receipt — and you can record your client's TRN too, for a proper business-to-business tax invoice.

items.title: Arabic tax invoices, fully right-to-left
items.body: Issue the same invoice in Arabic with correct right-to-left layout, Arabic numerals and a translated document — not a font swap on an English page.

items.title: Bill in AED, or in your client's money
items.body: Invoice in dirhams for local customers and in any of 140 currencies for clients abroad, while your own subscription is billed in AED wherever you are.

items.title: The tax-invoice format, branded as yours
items.body: Every PDF is laid out as a tax invoice and carries your logo, stamp and signature, your terms and your footer — the document your customer receives is yours end to end.

items.title: Payment links and automatic reminders
items.body: Share a link your client can pay from, and let Invroot chase what goes overdue, so the dirhams you have invoiced actually land.

items.q: Does Invroot handle UAE VAT at 5%?
items.a: Yes. Define a 5% VAT rate and Invroot applies it per line, shows the VAT amount separately and totals the invoice in AED — the structure a UAE tax invoice needs. You can also add zero-rated or exempt lines where they apply.

items.q: Can I show my TRN on the invoice?
items.a: Yes. Your Tax Registration Number appears on every invoice, quote and receipt, and you can record your customer's TRN as well for a business-to-business tax invoice.

items.q: Can I issue invoices in Arabic?
items.a: Yes. The interface switches to Arabic with full right-to-left layout, and you choose the language per invoice, so an Arabic-speaking client receives an Arabic document.

items.q: Can I bill clients outside the UAE?
items.a: Yes. Invoice international clients in any of 140 currencies while keeping your books and your own subscription in AED — the same account serves local and overseas customers.

items.q: Is there a free way to try it?
items.a: Yes. Start free with no card and send one real invoice to a real client, then move to Starter when you need more.
